conv.u: What is the difference between por and para?
conv.reply: Por vs. para (Por y para)Both words often come out as 'for' in English, but they face in opposite directions.1. Por: cause and motive — Por introduces the reason behind an action or feeling: because of, out of, on account of.e.g. Cerraron la carretera por un derrumbe. — They closed the road because of a landslide.2. Por: route, movement and vague place — Por describes movement through, along, around or past a place, and imprecise location (around here, somewhere near).e.g. Dimos un paseo por la Cinta Costera. — We took a walk along the Cinta Costera.3. Por: means and channels — Por names the medium of communication or transport: by phone, by email, by air.e.g. Te mando el contrato por correo electrónico. — I'll send you the contract by email.4. Por: exchange, price and substitution — Por marks what is given in exchange and the person or thing replaced: for, in exchange for, in place of, standing in for.e.g. Pagué doce dólares por estas sandalias. — I paid twelve dollars for these sandals.5. Por: time span, part of the day, rate — Por expresses how long something lasts, the part of the day, and rates such as 'per' and 'percent'.e.g. Viví en David por cuatro años. — I lived in David for four years.6. Por: agent, feelings, 'go and get', 'still to do' — Por introduces the doer in the passive, the object of a feeling, the thing you go to fetch, and what remains to be done.e.g. El puente fue diseñado por un ingeniero francés. — The bridge was designed by a French engineer.…6 more in the full guide (Grammar guides › Por vs. para).Say quiz me and I’ll quiz you on it, one question at a time.
